title: Setup → 人员与组织 shows two identical「组织」entries (zh-CN / ja-JP)
body:
## Symptom

In a multi-organization deployment, Setup → 人员与组织 (People & Organization) shows two menu entries both labelled 「组织」 (ja-JP: 「組織」). They open different pages, so an administrator cannot tell them apart.

## Cause

`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` contributes two different entries to `group_people_org`:

| id | en | opens | shown |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nav_organization` | Organization | the active organization's record page (Members / Invitations / Teams) | always |
| `nav_organizations` | Organizations | the organization list | only where `org-scoping` is mounted |

English tells them apart by the plural. zh-CN and ja-JP have no plural, and both keys translate to 「组织」 / 「組織」 in `translations/zh-CN.ts` / `translations/ja-JP.ts`.

## Fix

- zh-CN: 「当前组织」 / 「所有组织」
- ja-JP: 「現在の組織」 / 「すべての組織」
- A test fails when two entries in one Setup nav group read the same in any shipped locale.
